preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or become owner through transferOwnership)
Contract must hold some balance of its own tokens (xenoX)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the transferTokens function with the recipient set to your address and amount equal to the contract's token balance. This will drain all xenoX tokens held by the contract itself to the owner's address. The function uses token.transfer(recepient, amount) where token is IBEP20(address(this)), allowing the owner to transfer the contract's own token balance.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has a transferTokens function that allows the owner to transfer the contract's own token balance to any address. This is a classic owner privilege abuse where the owner can drain all tokens held by the contract. The function uses token.transfer(recepient, amount) where token is IBEP20(address(this)), meaning it transfers the contract's own xenoX tokens.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call transferTokens to drain all tokens from the contract to the attacker's address.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Get the contract's token balance. 4. Call transferTokens with attacker address and the full balance amount.
